scope: Complete unchanged compiler-backed jsoup development census after Java nominal dotted-name resolution; paired preservation controls on all four other known cohort repositories. Not held-out or broad quality confirmation.
registrationPhase: Before any candidate real-repository extraction; compiler regression and focused native tests have informed this implementation.

oracle.nonSourceCategories: Retain external fields, array lengths and class literals separately, as in the unchanged oracle.

candidate: Freeze a release binary after native qualification; bind exact source/build/test inputs, commands, outcomes and binary hashes. Version remains 0.3.30.

comparison.sourcePolicy: Read-only pinned clean repository; entire original extraction scope, fresh outputs for each frozen release binary. The source oracle only scores its registered 88-file Java 8 cohort; retain other graph records separately. Preserve all failures and graph omission warnings. Timing is operational only; no performance conclusion from these two observations.

scoring: Use the unchanged compiler capture, UTF-16 to UTF-8 conversion, exact target declaration and source owner joins. Retain the complete 3785 ordinary plus 529 enum-reference denominator.

Inventory every returned field/enum contact in the registered source files, including extra, wrong, ambiguous, unanchored and unmapped contacts. Any unsupported new contact requires source review and a correction before claiming precision.
Run the fresh preceding enum-fixed baseline against the same frozen oracle; compare its complete graph to the preserved preceding candidate graph. Retain all original results and failed attempts.

Report declaration joins, exact target-plus-owner occurrence recall, every miss and all precision failures separately for ordinary fields and enum constants; Graphify keeps its frozen environment and graph.
Compare whole graph additions/removals, identities, edge direction/multiplicity/provenance and omission warnings; do not infer functional community quality from graph changes.
Repeat complete verification and compare report bytes. Repeated verifier agreement is consistency evidence, not an independent source oracle.

Check each of the four non-Java baseline/candidate graph pairs byte-for-byte, including metadata and array order; compare to preserved originals, retaining all differences. Record timing operationally without speed claims.

requirements: Use complete clean pinned checkouts as read-only source inputs. Preserve every failure and omission warning; do not reduce input scope or selectively repeat.
Record both frozen binary hashes, command arguments, process exit/timeout/stream limits, raw logs and full artifact hashes for all eight observations.

Compare complete baseline/candidate graph bytes, including metadata and array order; also compare each to its original preserved Compass graph. Any difference is retained and investigated, not silently excluded.
Keep frozen Graphify graphs and environment unchanged. These controls do not rerun Graphify or establish a new paired quality score.
Repeat artifact verification and compare reports. Operational durations are recorded but do not establish a timing comparison.
The original Java census remains 3785 ordinary plus 529 enum occurrences. These controls do not add to its recall denominator or replace any earlier failed outcomes.

limitations: This is one known Java configuration; general cross-language superiority remains unproven.
The change was motivated by observed missed enum constants. All scores are development results, even though this follow-up protocol precedes candidate extraction.
No authored explanation, runtime feasibility, functional community or god-object classification claim follows.
